meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 Grok Bot 上处理 claude-mem 观察者任务时，它只回复 `<skip_summary reason="noise" />` 或一条完整 `<observation>` XML，不写散文。产出写入 outbox/{id}.txt。
howto.when: 接到 claude-mem 观察者作业时接管：为 inbox 作业写 outbox 文件；空闲、初始化或无工具结果时给 skip_summary，完成一个可检索单元时给 observation。

say.text: 处理 inbox 里的观察者作业，只写 outbox/{id}.txt
没有工具结果，返回 skip_summary
把这个改动写成一条 observation，含 4–10 条带路径的事实
say.note: 标题不用工具名，附叙事

howto.what_en: On Grok Bot it handles claude-mem observer jobs, replying only with <skip_summary .../> or one full <observation> XML, never prose. Output goes to outbox/{id}.txt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a claude-mem observer job arrives on Grok Bot: it writes outbox files for inbox jobs. Idle or no tool results give skip_summary; a finished searchable unit gives one observation.

say_en.text: Process the observer jobs in inbox, writing only outbox/{id}.txt
No tool results this time - return skip_summary
Write this change as one observation with 4-10 facts including paths
say_en.note: No tool names in the title; add narrative
